frameSubmissionUnknown: The image request may have been accepted, but its task ID is unknown. New generation is blocked to avoid duplicate charges. Check APIMart's task history before restoring the saved record.
frameTaskPending: The existing image task has no confirmed result. Use Generate remaining frames to query it. Editing is locked to avoid duplicate charges.
title: Turn a storyboard into a scene.
intro: Upload references and prepare your story. Review full-film storyboards before generating video, or try an offline demo.
configHint: Uses the repository .env or environment variables. Save entered keys to the local .env (ignored by Git), or keep them in server memory. Blank values keep existing keys; saved keys are never shown. This checks configuration, not remote balances.
configIncomplete: Setup incomplete · offline demo is ready
keyPlaceholder: Enter to update; leave blank to keep the existing key
llmKeyPlaceholder: Keep the existing key, or fall back to APIMart
llmModelsHint: Enter model IDs available from the selected service. Each stage can use a different model. Switching services keeps unsaved inputs while editing; saving applies the selected service.
rewriterHint: Composition planning and prompt rewriting use the selected service. Storyboard images are still generated through APIMart.
configSaved: Settings saved in server memory. Newly started jobs will use these settings.
promptLabel: What would you like to film?
promptPlaceholder: Describe the scene, motion, camera and dialogue. Refer to your images as Picture 1, Picture 2…
samplePrompt: Picture 1 is the main character. Soft morning light comes through a window. The character sits at a wooden table, slowly looks up at the camera and smiles. The camera gently moves from a medium shot to a close-up. Natural, quiet atmosphere with ambient sound.
uploadReferencesHint: PNG / JPG / WebP · up to 9 images
referenceOrder: Added in Picture 1, 2… order. Leave empty in offline demo to use a placeholder.
tooManyImages: Maximum 9 reference images: {current} already added, {added} selected.
jsonObjectRequired: The top level of film JSON must be an object.
jsonTooLarge: JSON exceeds 2 MB. Use a smaller file.
jsonImported: Imported {name}. Upload images using the checklist below; previous bindings were cleared.
framesShotHint: Draw a frame for each shot. Segments can run in parallel; useful for multiple characters, shots or precise staging.
framesFirstHint: One first frame per segment. Later segments use the previous final frame and run sequentially.
framesNoneHint: Use character references only and chain segments with their final frames. No storyboard image charges.
outputHint: This folder is remembered. New tasks get a dated subfolder; resumed tasks keep their original folder.
demoHint: No network or charges. Creates placeholder frames, a demo video and report, not AI-generated footage.
liveHint: Calls the configured video backend (ComfyUI / RunningHub) and model APIs, which may incur compute or API charges. Check your inputs and settings; generation may take several minutes.
submitHintDemo: No keys needed · try the full workflow
submitHintLive: Actual charges are determined by providers
submitHintBusy: A job is running. Wait for it to finish before creating another.
imagesRequired: Real generation requires at least 1 reference image.
secondsInvalid: Duration must be an integer from 5 to 15; current value: {value}.
progressRunning: Counts show files saved so far. Remote generation time varies; follow the logs for progress.
progressDemo: Offline demo outputs are ready. Placeholder footage verifies the workflow, not generation quality.
progressDone: Job finished. Review the logs, report and output files.
logsEmpty: Job created. Waiting for the first log entry…
resumeHint: Reuses the original inputs, mode, directory and saved state. Keep the local server running during generation.
resumeBlockedHint: Automatic resume is disabled because the remote submission status is unknown or the task reached terminal failure. Start a new generation or repair the target card manually to avoid duplicate charges.
artifactsHint: Click a filename to view / download
historyEmpty: No jobs yet. Try a new offline demo.
workspaceNote: Jobs and outputs stay on your machine. Closing the page does not stop a running job. After a server restart, review or resume it from history.
footer: H3 Workbench · Reference images to video, with a simpler workflow.
networkError: Cannot reach the local server: {error}. Check that it is still running.
persistConfig: Save to local .env for future sessions
configOnDisk: Local .env saved; these settings are active in this service.
configInMemory: Using the current environment; unsaved session settings are cleared when the service exits.
configSavedDisk: Settings saved to local .env and applied to subsequently started jobs.
seedPlaceholder: Leave blank for the CLI to choose
seedInvalid: Seed must be an integer JavaScript can represent exactly.
storyboardHint: Review the generated images. Expand a prompt to add or remove character references and regenerate that frame. Confirming all frames uses the current images.
frameWaiting: This frame has not been generated yet.
framePromptLabel: Prompt used to generate this image
framePromptRequired: Enter a prompt for this storyboard image.
regenerateDemoHint: Creates an offline placeholder without calling an image model or incurring charges.
regenerateLiveHint: Uses the repository APIMart image API only; other frames stay unchanged.
videoStale: The current storyboard has not been applied to the film. Any existing video and report are an older version; continue the film to update them.
playerUnavailable: The local Plyr player could not load. Check the static files and refresh.
filmReferenceHint: Import to list character and board references automatically. No image paths are needed; uploads are stored separately from the story JSON.
filmReferencesHint: Upload one image per character and one combined scene / prop board. Replacing an image does not change the story.
filmNotReady: Correct the JSON and wait for the reference checklist to finish parsing.
demoPlaceholders: Allow missing images to use placeholders in demo mode (no real footage)
resultTitle: Review frames and refine each segment.
resultIntro: Confirm the storyboard, generate video, then regenerate individual segments and reassemble the full film when ready.
reviewPageHint: Up to 12 frames per page. No individual approvals needed; expand to edit the prompt and character references.
reviewCarouselHint: Use ← / → or the buttons to browse frames and edit their prompts and character references. No individual approvals needed.
pageNumberInvalid: Invalid page “{value}”. Enter a whole number from 1 to {pages}.
framesNotReady: Frames are not ready yet. Check the job progress.
editFramePrompt: View / edit prompt and character references
reviewBeforeVideo: Review every page, then confirm once. Video uses the currently generated images; prompt and character reference drafts apply only after regeneration.
videoOlderVersion: Older video · latest changes not applied
scriptReviewHint: This job has no storyboard images. Expand segments to check the script and timing, then confirm the plan and generate video in one step.
stageFailedHint: Check the error and logs, correct your settings, then resume with the original inputs.
stageGeneratingFramesHint: This stage prepares frames only. Video generation will not start automatically.
stageGeneratingVideoHint: The video pipeline is running. The completed film will appear here.
stageReviewHint: Browse the storyboard pages and regenerate individual images if needed. When satisfied, confirm everything and generate video.
stageFinishedHint: Watch the film, review the report and download outputs.
stageScriptReviewHint: This job has no storyboard images. Review the script plan, then confirm it and generate video.
scriptBeforeVideo: The button confirms the current script plan and immediately starts video generation.
confirmFramesDemo: Confirm all frames & generate demo video
confirmFramesLive: Confirm all frames & generate video · paid
scriptPlanForReview: Review the script plan before confirming
frameDraftUnapplied: The prompt or character references have unapplied edits. The image is unchanged; regenerate it to apply them.
outputFolderSaved: Output folder saved for the next launch. Each new task will get its own dated subfolder.
segmentsHint: Each generated segment may contain several shots. Preview or regenerate a single segment, then reassemble the full video.
segmentDemoHint: Updates only this offline demo segment. No models or charges.
segmentSeamHint: This mode references the previous ending frame. Check the transition to the next segment after replacing this one; later segments will not regenerate automatically.
assemblyPending: Segments changed. The full video and report are still the previous version. Preview the changes, then reassemble.
assemblyHint: Joins all current segments in their original order locally, without generating new video. Updates the full video below after success.
assemblyMissing: All segments must be generated before assembly.
segmentsNeedFrames: Storyboard changes have not been applied. Confirm them and generate video from the Storyboard tab first.
stageRegeneratingSegmentHint: The original segment and full video remain playable until the new segment succeeds.
stageAssemblingHint: Joining all current clips locally. The previous full video remains available until the new one succeeds.
stageAwaitingAssemblyHint: Preview the new segment, then select Reassemble full video.
filmJsonPlaceholder: Paste a JSON storyboard or import a UTF-8 .json / .txt file. Download an example to see the format.
frameReferencesHint: The scene board and character images are sent in the order below. Choose characters imported in the first step; changes affect only this frame. The scene board is kept automatically.
frameCharactersEmpty: This frame has no character references.
frameReferencesUnavailable: Some references are unavailable. Remove missing character references, or restore the scene board before regenerating.
frameCharacterCatalogEmpty: No character references were imported in this job's first step.
frameCharactersAllSelected: All character references imported in the first step are selected.
frameReferenceNumberingHint: Character references have changed. Check the reference numbers and character descriptions in your prompt. Changes apply only when you regenerate.
frameModerationFailed: Content review failed. Automatic retries stopped. Edit the prompt, then manually regenerate this frame.
frameGenerationFailed: This frame failed and has been saved. Other frames continue. You can manually regenerate it later.
stageFramesIncomplete: Storyboard batch processed; some frames need repair
stageFramesIncompleteHint: Successful images are saved. Repair failed frames before confirming the storyboard and generating video. Failed items are not retried automatically.
segmentPromptLabelH3: H3 prompt to submit for this attempt
segmentFormatLabel: Edit format (switching does not convert text)
segmentDraftUnapplied: Draft not applied. The current video stays unchanged until you regenerate this segment.
segmentOtherFormatDraft: The other format also has a draft. Only the selected format will be applied.
segmentDraftConflict: The current prompt or clip version changed. Your draft is preserved. Review the prompts used by the current video, then explicitly adopt its version.
segmentRebaseDraft: Use this draft with the current version
segmentActivePrompts: Prompts used by the current video (source / H3)
segmentSavedPrompts: Saved prompts for this segment (source / H3)
segmentNoActiveSource: No active source prompt. A direct H3 version is not paired with the old source. Switching to source creates a new draft.
segmentNoActiveH3: No active H3 can be recovered. Offline demos do not fabricate model output.
segmentRetryCurrent: Generate this segment again with this prompt
segmentSourceCost: Changed source text or references require text rewriting before this segment is generated. Text and video charges may apply; other clips are unchanged.
segmentVideoCost: This creates a new generation of the target clip with new video charges. The full film is not reassembled automatically.
segmentTaskPending: This attempt was accepted. Resume the original task only. The previous video remains playable; new prompts cannot replace this attempt.
segmentSubmissionUnknown: Acceptance is unconfirmed and duplicate generation is blocked. Verify it with the provider and restore the original task ID.
segmentTerminalFailed: This task has terminally failed; resume will not pay again. Edit and explicitly generate again to create a new paid attempt.
segmentFailedAttempt: The last attempt was not applied. The editor retains its failed prompt; expand the current video prompts to see the active version.
segmentSourceChanged: Source inputs or references changed since this manual edit. The edited text is preserved; review character numbers, camera and prop states.
segmentReferencesHeading: References for this regeneration (actual upload order, read-only)
segmentReferenceHistoryUnknown: The old video has no saved reference order. This list describes the next regeneration, not its historical inputs.
segmentBoardOmitted: Nine-image limit: the reference sheet was omitted.
segmentFramesOmitted: Nine-image limit: the last {count} shots have no image slots and retain their original video storyboard text.
optimizeStoryboard: Optimize storyboard prompts with the LLM (camera framing + cross-shot locked looks)
optimizeStoryboardHint: Enabled by default: adds camera framing, set details and cross-shot locked character looks, falling back to raw shot text after 3 retries. Uncheck to draw directly from raw script text.
filmCastGroupSummary: {roles} characters currently using {sheets} character reference sheet(s) (model limit: {max} total references)
mergeSelectedCast: Merge selected into one sheet ({count} selected)
castMerged: Merged into a combined cast sheet: {names}. Upload one image containing these characters.
castSplit: Split cast group: {names}. Upload separate images for each character.
frameReferencesAtLimit: Reached the 9-reference-image limit; remove an unused character sheet from this frame before adding another.
segmentRewriteH3Live: Convert to English H3 prompt · paid
segmentSavedPromptsPendingVideo: Saved new prompts (current video is still the previous version)
segmentPromptsSavedNotInVideo: Prompts updated and saved. The current video is still the previous version until you regenerate this segment.
stagePromptsReady: Prompts updated — ready for video generation
stagePromptsReadyHint: Prompts are saved. Resume video generation or generate individual segments when ready.
filmCastOverLimitHint: A segment or storyboard frame currently needs {total} reference images, exceeding the {max}-image limit; merge characters into a shared sheet or adjust frame mode.
segmentSourceDraftConflict: Your unsaved source prompt draft conflicts with the latest version; rebase it before converting.
segmentsRewriteHint: Updates and saves English H3 prompts using the text model only (text model charges may apply), without calling the video backend or replacing existing clips; subsequent segment regenerations reuse them automatically.
segmentsRewriteDemoHint: Offline demo mode: generates local six-section English preview prompts only, with no model calls or charges.
stageRewritingPromptsHint: Generating and saving six-section English prompts via the text model (text model charges may apply); no paid video generation will start.
comfyKeyPlaceholder: Required for public HTTPS tunnels; optional for 127.0.0.1
comfyPresetFull20: full20 · 20-step native + EasyCache (544p steady framing, recommended)
colabAutoStartOnDemand: On · auto-trigger when entering video generation offline
runtimeDetailOnline: Connected to {url} ({device}) · auto-releases after 60 min idle.
runtimeDetailOffline: Tunnel is offline. Click Start Colab A100 to provision an instance, stage weights onto local SSD, and open the authenticated tunnel; no compute units are used until started.
runtimeDetailNoUrl: Configure and save COMFYUI_URL (plus COMFYUI_API_KEY for public tunnels) in Environment & API settings below first.
runtimeDetailCliUnavailable: Remote ComfyUI is offline and google-colab-cli is not installed locally. Start your Colab notebook manually in a browser to generate video directly, or install google-colab-cli for one-click control.
runtimeDetailProvisioning: Requesting a Colab A100 runtime, please wait…
runtimeDetailDriveAuth: Google Drive mount authorization is required to read model weights and tunnel keys. Open the consent link, grant access, then click Confirm below.
runtimeDetailStartingComfy: Copying ~75 GB of models onto local SSD and starting the authenticated tunnel (takes ~2–5 min on cold start)…
runtimeDetailStopping: Stopping and releasing the Colab runtime…
runtimeDetailOrphan: Unnamed active Colab session(s) detected ({sessions}). Release old sessions in the Colab web UI before starting to avoid duplicate A100 billing.
runtimeStopConfirmWarning: Video tasks are still active or queued (local active: {local}, remote queue: {queue}). Force-stopping will interrupt in-flight generation. Stop anyway?
runtimeStartedNotice: Colab A100 startup initiated; watch the runtime card for progress.
runtimeStoppedNotice: Colab runtime stopped and compute released.
